features.hash: SHA-256 first eight bytes, big-endian modulo 512, signed by digest byte eight low bit

training.selection: No held-out split is used for hyperparameter tuning in this POC.

evaluation.calibration_and_policy: Not implemented; model scoring is not a policy decision.

retention: in-memory only; no model artifact, per-record predictions, or candidate text are written
acceptance: Use grouped held-out metrics against the versioned Phase 1 quality gate as evidence only. A scanner classification path still requires calibration, policy, and later owner review.
